dimensions.basis: deterministic verifier — a fixed specification, bound and independent replay; a model's own self-assessment is never a proof
the 5B recorded program observation and regression (independent of the model); NOT_APPLICABLE for synthetic tasks, never filled in as a pass
heuristic signal — did the answer state the scope / bound / unknowns; recorded only, not adjudicated (no human review in this batch)
heuristic signal on the answer's explicit risk / permission statements; no inference of any internal awareness
the 6A call/answer classification plus the task's predefined eligibility; REFERENCE_UNCERTAIN when the basis is insufficient
verified valid content and usage as reported; unknown usage stays unknown

notes: deterministic verifiers are primary; no LLM judge and no human review were used in this batch, so no dimension is marked expert-reviewed

refusal, a wrong answer and a transport failure are distinct events; 'no refusal' is not a breach, and a violated program property, a wrong model answer and a provider behaviour are not the same metric
a provider-policy attribution would need a dated public policy basis and is not made here
